response.summary: The revised plan resolves the round-1 findings, and I found no new material defects. It keeps the legacy `and-or` and `de-morgan` units reachable and keeps their saved work from being orphaned. I confirmed this in the source: nothing needs a migration if the four-member `CONDITIONAL_OPENING_UNIT_IDS` stays unchanged. One low-severity reminder remains for the builder, and the plan's checklist and tests already name it. I did not run tests.

findings.evidence: These lines are existing behavior that the build will change. A student with only an `and-or` or `de-morgan` skill assignment used to get `LearningPath`. Once Chapter 2 steps use those topics for access, `hasCourseSteps` becomes true and they get the numbered course, with the legacy unit shown under 'Additional assigned material'. Line 223 says 'outside the numbered Part 1 course', which becomes inaccurate. The spec already requires truthful copy and an access matrix, so this is a reminder rather than a plan gap.
findings.fix: In the access-matrix tests, assert that a legacy and-or-only learn assignment still reaches its lesson, guided and practice routes. Assert that a practice-only assignment does not see learn-only Chapter 2 steps. Update the line 223 copy.

coverage: Re-read the revised plan sections on integration, access and difficulty.

Searched all non-test uses of CONDITIONAL_OPENING_UNIT_IDS, conditionalOpeningEditionKey and OPENING_COURSE_PATH (routes.tsx, progress.ts, openingRevision.ts, OpeningCourse.tsx, ConditionalOpeningPreview.tsx).

Confirmed that leaving the four-member constant unchanged keeps these working as before: expanded-review gating (progress.ts:56), the recorded-practice list (routes.tsx:191/269), and legacy units appearing as additional material (routes.tsx:222).
Confirmed from my earlier read that the drill-step check uses action 'guided', which requires learn mode, so practice-only assignments are excluded.
limitations: I did not re-inspect the vault source, teaching-standard or DESIGN.md files, or the media pipeline. Source fidelity, design and copy quality are not covered.
I did not trace the course-completion denominator or the progress.course persistence code in detail.
I could not run tests or the build, so I make no passing claim.
I did not review the implementation, because none exists yet.
